doc.name: Arctic White
doc.instructions: Arctic White (arcticsci.com) sells laboratory consumables in the US and internationally: microplates, deep well plates, reservoirs, sealing mats and films, tubes, filter plates and lab equipment. Find products with search_products and get_product. Prices are in USD per selling unit (usually a case); many items are priced on request. To buy items with published prices, call check_price_and_stock, then get_shipping_estimate, then start_checkout, and give the buyer the checkout link: they pay on arcticsci.com. For items priced on request, large orders, POs or net terms, use request_quote; the buyer confirms it by email. Never claim an order is placed or paid: the buyer completes payment on the link. Phone (888) 448-0311, hello@arcticsci.com.

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search Arctic White's catalog of lab consumables (microplates, deep well plates, reservoirs, sealing mats and films, tubes, filter plates, lab equipment) by catalog number, a competitor's part number, name, well count or type. Returns SKUs, published prices (or 'pricing on request'), stock and product links.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. '96 deep well 2 mL', 'AWLS-219006', 'sealing mat 384'

limit.description: Most results to return (1 to 25, default 10)

results.description: Matching products, best match first. Empty when nothing matches.

replaces.description: The competitor part this product replaces, when found through that part number

quote_only.description: True for a custom made, quote-only product: it has no price and cannot be checked out; use request_quote

standard_alternative.description: For a quote-only product, the closest standard product sold today; null otherwise or when none is set

items.description: One orderable option of the product.

option.description: Option name (e.g. Sterile), null when the product has one option

price_usd.description: Published price per selling unit in USD, null when priced on request

price.description: Price as shown, e.g. $246.00, or Pricing on request

availability.description: Stock status: in_stock, backorder (available to order) or out_of_stock

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product details
tools.description: Full details for one product: description, specifications and dimensions, options with SKU, price and stock, image and page link.

sku.description: SKU (e.g. AWLS-219006) or an arcticsci.com product link

discontinued.description: True when the product is discontinued

quote_only.description: True for a custom made, quote-only product: it has no price and cannot be checked out; use request_quote

standard_alternative.description: For a quote-only product, the closest standard product sold today; null otherwise or when none is set

specifications.description: Specifications and dimensions, in display order

items.description: One orderable option of the product.

option.description: Option name (e.g. Sterile), null when the product has one option

price_usd.description: Published price per selling unit in USD, null when priced on request

price.description: Price as shown, e.g. $246.00, or Pricing on request

availability.description: Stock status: in_stock, backorder (available to order) or out_of_stock

image_url.description: Main product image, null when there is none

tools.name: check_price_and_stock
tools.title: Check price and stock
tools.description: Price and stock for a list of items, the subtotal, and whether the order can be bought online now (published prices, within the payment limits) or needs a quote.

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

unit_price_usd.description: Price per selling unit in USD, null when priced on request

line_total_usd.description: Quantity times unit price in USD, null when priced on request

availability.description: Stock status: in_stock, backorder (available to order) or out_of_stock

subtotal_usd.description: Goods subtotal in USD before shipping and tax, null when any item is priced on request

can_checkout.description: True when start_checkout can sell these items now; otherwise use request_quote

reason.description: Why the items can't be bought online, null when they can

tools.name: get_shipping_estimate
tools.title: Get shipping estimate
tools.description: Live FedEx shipping options and prices for the items to a destination, the same rates checkout charges. Needs only the country, postal code and, in the US and Canada, the state.

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

address.description: Where the items ship to. state is required only in the US and Canada (2-letter code). zip is required except in countries without postal codes.

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. US, DE, GB

state.description: 2-letter state or province code in the US and Canada (e.g. PA, ON); region name or blank elsewhere

rates.description: Shipping options, as offered by the carrier

id.description: Pass this to start_checkout as shipping_rate_id

service.description: Carrier and service, e.g. FedEx Ground

estimated_days.description: Estimated business days in transit, null when the carrier gives none

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.title: Start checkout
tools.description: Create a secure Stripe checkout link on arcticsci.com for items with published prices. The buyer opens the link to review the order, see sales tax and pay; nothing is charged until they do. Use the shipping option id from get_shipping_estimate, or leave it out for the lowest rate. Items priced on request, custom made (quote_only) products, or orders over the payment limits need request_quote instead.

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

address.description: Shipping address. state is required only in the US and Canada (2-letter code); elsewhere it is optional. zip is required except in countries without postal codes.

company.description: Company or institution. Required: Arctic White ships to businesses and labs.

state.description: 2-letter state or province code in the US and Canada (e.g. PA, ON); region name or blank elsewhere

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. US, DE, GB

email.description: Buyer's email, prefilled on the payment page (optional)

shipping_rate_id.description: id from get_shipping_estimate (optional; the lowest rate is used when left out)

checkout_url.description: Stripe payment page on arcticsci.com's account. Give it to the buyer; it expires in 24 hours.

shipping_service.description: Carrier and service, e.g. FedEx Ground

tools.name: request_quote
tools.title: Request a quote
tools.description: Ask Arctic White for a quote (any items, including those priced on request, large orders, POs or net terms). We email the buyer a link to confirm the request; once confirmed, our team replies with pricing.

email.description: Buyer's work email; they confirm the request from it

note.description: Anything the team should know: timeline, PO, terms, freight account (optional)

address.description: Shipping address. state is required only in the US and Canada (2-letter code); elsewhere it is optional. zip is required except in countries without postal codes.

company.description: Company or institution (optional here; give it as the top-level company)

state.description: 2-letter state or province code in the US and Canada (e.g. PA, ON); region name or blank elsewhere

country.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. US, DE, GB

items.description: Products and quantities. Quantity is in the product's selling unit (usually cases).

status.description: The request waits for the buyer to confirm it from the email

email.description: Where the confirmation link was sent
